deviations.what: the firmware ask (place non-book kinds under /xteink/<kind>s/) is a comment on agentculture/xteink#8, not its own issue on agentculture/xteink-firmware
deviations.reason: agentculture/xteink-firmware is a fork of crosspoint-reader with GitHub issues disabled (gh: hasIssuesEnabled false); tracking both halves on xteink#8 keeps them in one thread without changing that repo's settings

deviations.what: llm.complete gains content_path + content_root + max_chars (it reads the transcript excerpt from the file under the root itself), so the transcript text never enters run state; the 1-2 line summary reply stays a step output (llm.complete's text), and h12's 'step outputs hold no summary text' is relaxed to 'no transcript text'
deviations.reason: steps pass data through persisted step outputs (run documents in local Mongo, shown in the editor's Debug view); chaining the excerpt and the reply that way would store up to 48000 transcript characters per run. Operator 2026-10-24 chose: keep the transcript out, allow the short summary

deviations.what: one rule pocket-to-reader with an OR condition (zipformer finished, or whisper finished on an en recording); the editor's fold (culture_rules/model/paragraph.py and its TS twin web/src/fold/model.ts) learns to read predecessors through OR, so the rule shows as continuing from transcribe-file-he or transcribe-file
deviations.reason: the fold found a continuation's predecessor only through AND, so the OR rule read as continuing from every workflow (the newspaper and pr-fix paragraphs gained 'Then it continues into transcript-to-reader'); operator 2026-10-24 chose one rule with OR over splitting it

deviations.what: transcript.render caches the finished book beside its transcript: the first render writes book.<transcript sha256 prefix>.epub (+ a small .json of its title, date, word, summary_used, segment_count) into the recording's subfolder under the root; a later run for the same transcript file returns those stored bytes and fields unchanged, so a re-run uploads identical bytes and xteink deduplicates them (c11). Also: llm.complete refuses an empty content_path excerpt (invalid_request); the catalog notes content_path needs content_root; the editor's Then column words an either continuation; the render caps' relationship is documented
deviations.reason: colleague review finding A: the summary is asked again on every run and the model may answer differently, so new bytes would make a second book (c11's test used a fixed fake reply and could not show it). Decider (general, 2026-10-24) on four options: cache_book_file 0.93, delivered_record 0.03, library_title_check 0.02, accept_and_document 0.02; cache safe P=0.88; harm unfixed negligible 0.50 / minor 0.47. Findings B-E are small fixes from the same review
